Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24184
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/23217
Merged duplicate: issues 23217 (April 2026 report of the March 6 portal shutdown) and 24184 (August 2026 report of the 16-customer finding) describe the same Halifax Water Customer Connect breach, so one record closes both.
Partner_Breach tag (24184): coded from the partner's perspective per the project rule. Primary victim Avertra, the vendor that operates the Customer Connect platform; Halifax Water is the secondary victim. The incident_id reuses EF10B58F-5EBA-4CB5-9877-D3B973865FF6 from the row already in Partner_Breaches_2027_dbir.csv so the two stay linked, but the coding here differs from that row (see below).
Action: Halifax Water says 'an unauthorized external party accessed information linked to 16 customer accounts' through a vulnerability in the third-party platform. Coded Hacking Exploit vuln, vector Web application, external actor (variety and motive Unknown). The issue's Error-int-misconfig-srv tag and the CSV row coded this as a Misconfiguration error; the vendor update that re-exposed a patched flaw is a contributing control failure, but per the style guide only the overt action (the external access) is coded. A reviewer may add Error (partner, Programming error) if preferred. The party who emailed about the flaw may have been a researcher; nothing says the data was misused.
Data: names, emails, addresses, account/customer/user IDs (Personal) and security questions and answers (Credentials), 16 accounts. No financial data. data_total 16.
Discovery: an outside party emailed about the flaw (February, dismissed as spam; March, escalated) -> external Unrelated 3rd party.
Timeline: the flaw was found by Halifax Water in November 2025 and patched, then re-exposed by a January 2026 vendor update; the access window is not stated, so year 2026 is coded (dbir_year 2027). Portal offline from March 6, 2026 for at least five months (containment coded Months).
Victim: Avertra (utility customer-experience software vendor, Reston, Virginia; NAICS 511210 to match the CSV; employee count approximate). Halifax Water NAICS 221310 from the issue.
Asset: the vendor-hosted portal and its database (External Cloud Asset(s)); role IT. Halifax Water says water/wastewater control systems were not involved.

event_chain.summary: Exploit vuln in vendor portal; 16 customer records accessed

summary: An unauthorized external party exploited a vulnerability in Avertra's platform behind Halifax Water's Customer Connect portal and accessed information tied to 16 customer accounts: full names, email addresses, service addresses, account, customer and user IDs, and security questions and answers. Halifax Water had found and reported the flaw to Avertra in November 2025 and a patch was applied, but a January 2026 vendor software update re-exposed it. An unknown party's email about the flaw in February 2026 was dismissed as spam; a follow-up in March 2026 was escalated, and on March 6 the portal (about 55,000 account holders) was taken offline. A forensic investigation confirmed 16 affected accounts in May 2026 and they were notified in June; further vulnerabilities kept the portal offline into August 2026.
